added_examples.translation: And also there were many of the Muslims here, originally, their origin still from the genocide, so to say victims of the genocide, many of them, of their grandfathers and of their elders, they converted to Islam to escape the slaughter.
added_examples.rationale: Sole attestation for the new proposed entry and Detransitive Part. Pass. box. Keep full Turoyo and the edition's English; English 'victims' is not adopted as the lexical gloss.
